senses.definition: n.pr.m. ((the) Exalted One is (my) father (v. BaeRel 156) cf. Assyrian Aburamu (?) KAT2 479 cf. DlL2, p. 91, 1. 225).
a Reubenite, son of Eliab Nu 16:1, 12, 24, 25, 27(×2); 26:9 Dt 11:6 ψ 106:17.
son of Hiel the Bethelite 1 K 16:34. Cf. also following.
